meaning: flowing honey, honey from the comb, a dropping down, honey, honeycomb

elsewhere.note: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
